Gestalt Python SDK¶

Use gestalt to build executable Gestalt providers with Python models, decorators, runtime providers, host-service clients, and telemetry helpers.

The package is published as gestalt-sdk and imported as gestalt in provider projects.

This reference focuses on the handwritten Python SDK surface. Runtime transport internals are intentionally excluded from these authored pages.

API sections¶

The API reference is organized by the provider-authoring workflow:

  • Core authoring types for models, request and response wrappers, and operation results.

  • App authoring for executable app definitions, catalogs, session catalogs, and HTTP subject resolution.

  • Workflow helpers for native workflow target, run, schedule, signal, and event values.

  • Agent provider models for agent sessions, turns, messages, tools, and provider responses.

  • Provider interfaces for executable provider surfaces and authentication payloads.

  • Provider telemetry for provider-authored GenAI spans and metrics.

  • Storage and host-service clients for cache, IndexedDB, S3, manager, invocation, and runtime-log clients.
